title: 进程被附加调试(ptrace)
desc: 有程序用 ptrace 附加到另一个进程，可读写其内存、劫持执行，常见于调试器，也是注入/提权的常用手法。
desc_en: A program used ptrace to attach to another process, letting it read/write that process's memory and hijack its execution — common in debuggers, but also a standard injection/privilege-escalation technique.

title: 跨进程写内存(process_vm_writev)
desc: 一个进程直接写入另一个进程的内存空间，正常程序极少这样做，常见于代码注入。
desc_en: A process wrote directly into another process's memory space — normal programs almost never do this; it's a common code-injection technique.

title: 出现同时可写又可执行的内存页
desc: 内存页被设置为“既能写入又能执行”，是代码注入/shellcode 的典型特征，正常程序很少需要这样的权限组合。
title_en: A memory page became writable AND executable
desc_en: A memory page was set to be both writable and executable — a classic signature of code injection/shellcode; normal programs rarely need this combination.

title: 访问系统密码库(/etc/shadow)
desc: /etc/shadow 保存所有账户的加密密码，正常程序不会读写它，常见于提权或信息窃取。
desc_en: /etc/shadow holds every account's encrypted password hash; normal programs never read or write it — common in privilege escalation or credential theft.

title: 直接读写另一个进程的内存文件
desc: /proc/<pid>/mem 是进程内存的直接映射，读写它等同于直接操作该进程的内存。
title_en: Directly read/wrote another process's memory file
desc_en: /proc/<pid>/mem is a direct mapping of a process's memory — reading or writing it is equivalent to directly manipulating that process's memory.

title: 访问 SSH 私钥/授权文件
desc: SSH 密钥用于免密登录其它机器，被读取可能意味着密钥被窃取或正在被用于横向移动。
title_en: Accessed an SSH private key / authorized_keys file
desc_en: SSH keys enable passwordless login to other machines; reading them may mean a key is being stolen or used for lateral movement.

title: 执行了临时目录下的程序
desc: /tmp、/dev/shm 等临时目录下的可执行文件被直接运行，是恶意软件落地执行的常见位置。
title_en: Ran a program from a temporary directory
desc_en: An executable under /tmp, /dev/shm, etc. was run directly — a common drop-and-execute location for malware.

title: 加载了内核模块
desc: 内核模块拥有和操作系统内核同等的权限，加载未知模块风险极高，rootkit 常借此隐藏自身。
desc_en: Kernel modules run with the same privileges as the OS kernel itself; loading an unknown one is extremely high-risk, and rootkits commonly use this to hide themselves.

title: 进程提权为 root
desc: 一个进程把自己的用户身份切换成了 root(超级管理员)，获得了对系统的完全控制权。
desc_en: A process switched its own user identity to root (superuser), gaining full control over the system.

title: 在常见后门端口监听
desc: 这些端口号常被恶意程序/反弹shell使用，虽然也可能是正常测试，仍建议确认一下。
title_en: Listening on a common backdoor port
desc_en: These port numbers are commonly used by malware/reverse shells — it could still be legitimate testing, but worth a second look.

title: 尝试清除命令历史
desc: 清空或禁用命令历史记录是攻击者常用的痕迹清理手段。
desc_en: Clearing or disabling command history is a common attacker technique for covering their tracks.

title: 修改系统配置文件(/etc)
desc: /etc 目录存放系统级配置，修改它可能影响系统行为、新增用户或改变启动项。
desc_en: /etc holds system-level configuration; changing it can affect system behaviour, add users, or alter startup items.

title: 修改定时任务(crontab)
desc: 定时任务可以让程序在未来某个时间自动运行，常被用来做持久化驻留。
desc_en: Scheduled tasks let a program run automatically at a future time — commonly used to establish persistence.

title: 修改 Shell 启动脚本
desc: 这些文件会在你每次打开终端时自动执行，被修改可能意味着被植入了自动触发的命令。
desc_en: These files run automatically every time you open a terminal — a change may mean an auto-triggered command was planted.

title: 修改系统服务配置(systemd)
desc: systemd 服务配置决定了开机自动启动哪些程序，是常见的持久化驻留位置。
desc_en: systemd service configs decide what auto-starts at boot — a common persistence location.

title: 发起网络连接
desc: 程序主动连接了外部网络地址，多数应用的联网行为都是正常的，建议关注目标地址是否可信。
desc_en: A program actively connected to an external address — most networking is normal, but it's worth noting whether the destination is trusted.

title: 开始监听网络端口
desc: 程序打开了一个端口等待外部连接进来，常见于服务器、开发调试工具。
title_en: Started listening on a network port
desc_en: A program opened a port to wait for incoming connections — common for servers and dev/debug tools.

title: SSH 登录活动
desc: 检测到 SSH 远程登录相关的活动，请确认来源是否是你本人或受信任的设备。
desc_en: SSH remote-login activity was detected — confirm whether the source is you or a trusted device.

title: 数据库查询语句
desc: 捕获到一条数据库(MySQL/PostgreSQL)查询语句，便于审计数据访问行为。
desc_en: A database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) query was captured, for auditing data-access behaviour.

title: 捕获到加密流量的明文内容
desc: 在数据被加密发送前(或解密后)拿到了原始内容，用于审计程序到底传输了什么，不代表数据被泄露。
desc_en: The raw content was captured before encryption (or after decryption), to audit what a program actually transmits — this is not itself a data leak.

title: 大量磁盘写入
desc: 程序正在进行较大量的磁盘写入操作，常见于下载、编译、日志或数据库写入。
desc_en: A program is doing a substantial amount of disk writing — common for downloads, compilation, logging, or database writes.
